methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Value paid to suppliers: the node-operator (RUNE bonder) share of swap fees set by the Incentive Pendulum (a security cost), the liquidity-provider share of swap fees (LP side of the Incentive Pendulum), affiliate fees passed through to integrators, the 10% of swap fees paid to TCY stakers, and the outbound gas costs reimbursed from the Reserve to nodes.

methodology.Fees: Flat 4 bps (0.04%) trading fee applied to daily USD volume matched on Primit's own engine. Computed as `dailyVolume * 4 / 10000` on the same volume figure derived above.
methodology.Revenue: 100% of trading fees collected on Primit-native pairs accrue to the protocol. No LP or affiliate revenue share is applied to this pair set, so Revenue equals Fees.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: Same as Revenue. All protocol-native trading fees stay with the protocol.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Fees going to governance token holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: Zero. Primit-native pairs are not backed by an external liquidity-provider vault today — no maker rebate, no LP share, no affiliate share — so nothing from the fee stream accrues to a supply side. Preserves the DeFiLlama contract dailyFees = dailyRevenue + dailySupplySideRevenue.
methodology.Volume: Sum of `price * amount` for every TradeRecorded event emitted by Primit's TradeRecorder contract (0xC005A9bb11f162329f3EfCCc35F69F9Bb635EeC6 on Avalanche C-Chain) during the UTC day, excluding self-trades where taker == maker. Both `price` and `amount` are 1e18 fixed-point, so the product is scaled by 1e36 and normalized down to floating USD before returning. Data is 100% reconstructable on-chain — no dependency on any Primit-operated HTTP endpoint. Volume routed through Orderly Network (BTC/ETH/etc via broker_id=primit) is attributed separately by factory/orderly.ts and NOT double-counted here.

methodology.Revenue: Each pool sets how much of its swap fee the protocol keeps, and HyperSwap switches that on one pool at a time, so the share is read from each pool individually for the day being measured. Of whatever the protocol keeps, 25% goes to the treasury and 75% buys back and burns SWAP.

methodology.Volume: Total ETH planted on the grid, taken from the Planted and PlantedMany events.
methodology.Fees: Every plant pays an admin fee, at the configured adminFeeBps rate (1% at time of writing), on the AAPL bought with it. Every revealed round with a winner pays that round's configured rakeBps on the loss pool (the stakes on the 24 plots that did not bloom), split into a fixed 10% to SEED stakers (STAKERS_BPS, a contract constant), the round's configured jackpotBps share to the Golden Apple jackpot, and the remainder to the treasury. Rounds where the blooming plot is empty take no rake — the whole pot rolls into the jackpot.
methodology.UserFees: Same as Fees — both the admin fee and the rake are paid by players out of what they planted.
methodology.Revenue: Gross profit: the admin fee plus the stakers and treasury cuts of the rake. The jackpot cut is excluded because it is paid back out to players.
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: The admin fee taken on every plant at the configured adminFeeBps rate, withdrawn by the owner via collectAdmin.
methodology.HoldersRevenue: Value reaching SEED holders: the fixed 10% of each round's rake flushed to SeedStaking as AAPL yield for stakers, plus the treasury remainder that buys SEED back on the DEX and burns it.
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: The round's configured jackpotBps share of its rake, routed to the Golden Apple jackpot and paid back out to players when it hits.
